user: Design a bench rack for 25 15 mL conical tubes. It is a solid rectangular block 118 mm long (X), 118 mm wide (Y) and 25 mm tall (Z). It has 25 vertical holes in 5 rows (along Y) of 5 (along X), 22 mm centre-to-centre in both directions, with the hole grid centred on the block. Each hole is 17.5 mm in diameter and 21 mm deep, open at the top and closed at the bottom, leaving a 4 mm solid floor.
